description_en: You can invoke ListIntervalAgentReport to obtain the segment statistical report of a specified agent under a specified instance
description_zh: 调用ListIntervalAgentReport获取指定实例下指定坐席的分段统计报表
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-interval-agent-report --agent-id agent@ccc-test --instance-id ccc-test --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListIntervalAgentReport

parameters.help_en: Start time, formatted as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter is optional. The default value is 00:00:00 of the current day. Time precision for statistics is at the hour level, rounded down to the previous full hour, using a closed interval
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒，非必填，默认为当天的0时，统计的时间精度为小时，向前取整，闭区间
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: End time, formatted as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter is optional. The default value is the current time. If Interval is Daily, the maximum interval between StartTime and EndTime is 180 days. If Interval is Hourly, the maximum interval is 10 days. Time precision for statistics is at the hour level, rounded down to the next full hour, using an open interval. For example, if the start time is 11:12:20 and the end time is 11:45:50, the aligned input time range becomes [11:00:00, 12:00:00), meaning greater than or equal to 11:00:00 and less than 12:00:00
parameters.help_zh: 截止时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒，非必填，默认是当前时间，如果Interval为Daily，StartTime和EndTime最大间隔是180天。如果Interval为Hourly，最大间隔时间为10天。统计的时间精度为小时，向后取整，开区间。例如：开始时间为11:12:20，结束时间为11:45:50，则对齐后的入参时间范围为[11:00:00,12:00:00)，即大于等于11点，小于12点
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: Segment statistics type. Optional. Default value is Daily (aggregated by Day)
parameters.help_zh: 分段统计类型，非必填，默认为Daily（按天汇总）
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: Media type. The default value is Audio. Other valid values include Chat and Video
parameters.help_zh: 媒体类型，默认是语音(Audio), 其他可选参数包括Chat和Video
parameters.name: media_type

Data.description_zh: 坐席分段统计数据列表

AnswerRate.description_en: Answer rate. Calculation Formula: CallsAnswered / CallsDialed. (Because answer events and acknowledgement events may fall into different time ranges, the result may exceed 100% in certain cases.)
AnswerRate.description_zh: 接通率，计算公式为：CallsAnswered/CallsDialed（由于接听事件与应答事件可能落在不同的时间范围内，所以某些情况下结果可能大于100%）

AverageCustomerRingTime.description_en: Average customer-side ring duration in seconds
AverageCustomerRingTime.description_zh: 平均客户侧振铃时长，单位秒

CallsAgentHandled.description_en: Number of calls answered by agents

CallsCustomerAnswered.description_en: Number of calls answered by customers

MaxCustomerRingTime.description_en: Maximum customer-side ring time, in seconds
MaxCustomerRingTime.description_zh: 最大客户侧振铃时长，单位秒

TotalCustomerRingTime.description_en: Total customer-side ring time, in seconds
TotalCustomerRingTime.description_zh: 总客户侧振岭时长，单位秒

AverageFirstResponseTime.description_en: Average first response time for chat sessions, in seconds
AverageFirstResponseTime.description_zh: Chat会话平均首次响应时长，单位为秒

AverageHoldTime.description_en: Average hold time during calls, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalHoldTime / CallsHold
AverageHoldTime.description_zh: 平均通话保持时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalHoldTime/CallsHold

AverageResponseTime.description_en: Average response time for chat sessions

AverageRingTime.description_en: Average ring time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalRingTime / CallsRinged
AverageRingTime.description_zh: 平均振铃时长，单位秒。计算公式为： TotalRingTime/CallsRinged

AverageTalkTime.description_en: Average talk time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalTalkTime / CallsHandled
AverageTalkTime.description_zh: 平均通话时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalTalkTime/CallsHandled

AverageWorkTime.description_en: Average post-processing time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalWorkTime / CallsHandled
AverageWorkTime.description_zh: 平均话后处理时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalWorkTime/CallsHandled

CallsAttendedTransferOut.description_zh: 咨询转出量。若一通电话多次转出给其他坐席，每次转出算一次

CallsBlindTransferIn.description_en: Number of blind transfer-in calls. If a single call is transferred in to this agent multiple times, each transfer counts as one
CallsBlindTransferIn.description_zh: 直接转入量。若一通电话多次转入给该坐席，每次转入算一次

CallsBlindTransferOut.description_en: Number of blind transfer-out calls. If a single call is transferred out to other agents multiple times, each transfer counts as one
CallsBlindTransferOut.description_zh: 直接转出量。若一通电话多次转出给其他坐席，每次转出算一次

CallsHandled.description_en: Acknowledgement count, which is the number of times agents answered calls
CallsHandled.description_zh: 应答量，即坐席应答的次数

CallsHold.description_en: Number of calls placed on hold, that is, the count of occurrences where a call was held
CallsHold.description_zh: 保持量，即发生通话保持的次数

HandleRate.description_zh: 应答率。计算公式为：CallsHandled / CallsOffered（由于应答事件与分配事件可能落在不同的时间范围内，所以某些情况下结果可能大于100%）
